roma-craft--cromagnon-aquitaine.description: Launched at the 2012 trade show, Aquitaine wraps Nicaraguan filler from Estelí, Condega and a Pueblo Nuevo ligero in an Ecuadorian Habano ligero from the eighth and ninth primings, over a Cameroon binder. A strong, savoury cigar where pepper and oak carry the smoke toward an espresso finish.

thirds.notes: Wood and faint florals open, then pepper takes hold with leather and a natural, fruity sweetness.
Pepper dominates at the midpoint, then oak returns to balance it as coffee notes surface.
Espresso and coffee bean come forward with pepper and oak, plus a smoky, mesquite-like edge.

sources.title: The Cigar Authority – CroMagnon Aquitaine review

roma-craft--intemperance-ec-xviii.description: RoMa Craft's lighter line from its NicaSueño factory in Estelí, released in 2012: an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over an Indonesian binder, with Nicaraguan and Dominican filler. It offers cedar, cream and honey with gentle spice, a calm smoke for the morning or early afternoon.

thirds.notes: Cedar and cream with nutty notes and a little red pepper, as a faint honeyed sweetness appears.
Honey and cream take over, with vanilla and a cinnamon-like spice; the pepper eases.
Earth and nuts lead as the sweetness fades; pepper comes back toward the end, with a touch of dried fruit.

sources.title: The Cigar Authority – Intemperance EC XVIII Faith review
Cigar Reviews by the Katman – Intemperance EC XVIII Brotherly Kindness

roma-craft--intemperance-ba-xxi.description: The darker sibling of EC XVIII, made at NicaSueño in Estelí since early 2012 with a Brazilian Arapiraca wrapper over an Indonesian binder and Nicaraguan and Dominican filler. A balanced, chocolate-and-espresso smoke with leather, wood and red pepper.

thirds.notes: Dark chocolate and espresso with red pepper, leather, wood and a hint of citrus fruit.
Leather moves ahead, the smoke turns creamy, and wood, earth and a toasty, meaty note fill in.
Coffee and pepper return over dry wood and cedar, with cocoa still in the background.

sources.title: The Cigar Authority – Intemperance BA XXI Breach of the Peace review
Cigar Reviews by the Katman – Intemperance BA XXI Breach of the Peace

roma-craft--neanderthal.description: A strong line on the market since 2015 and made at NicaSueño: a Mexican San Andrés maduro wrapper and Connecticut Broadleaf binder around Nicaraguan, Dominican and high-nicotine Pennsylvania double-ligero filler. Dense with earth, chocolate and pepper, it suits a seasoned smoker.

thirds.notes: A blast of pepper over earth and dark chocolate, with dark fruit and a bright, zesty edge.
Chocolate and coffee settle in front, earth and oak deepen, and sweetness grows under the pepper.
Earth and coffee lead to the end, with pepper on the retrohale and a toasted nut note.

sources.title: Casa Sfumando – RoMa Craft Neanderthal review

roma-craft--cromagnon.description: One of RoMa Craft's first lines, made at its NicaSueño factory in Estelí with Nicaraguan filler. Its Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper gave way to Pennsylvania Broadleaf Maduro at the end of 2023, with the blend adjusted to suit. A strong, rustic cigar meant for experienced smokers.

sources.title: The Cigar Authority – CroMagnon Knuckle Dragger review
